budget.completion_caveat: Empirical cost prediction; hard caps bound spending, not successful completion. No automatic retries.
budget.rule: 2 x maximum observed isolated size/method wall or measured child CPU + 60 s; floor 60; no clipping

limitations: No-outcome-evidence is conditional on the local tree, available archive inventories, and local Git refs; it is not proof against unavailable external experiments.
Prior plan-only/reference-only exposure is disclosed but is not an optimizer outcome.
One DoD and seed; family subgroup estimates are exploratory; three parents per family limit bootstrap precision.
Blocked designs have no selected cohort/jobs; budget is the hypothetical 18-parent design, not execution authorization.
selection_rule: Three lexicographically first no-outcome-evidence parents per family, all sizes and DoD eligible; abort whole selection if any family lacks three.

statistics.bootstrap: 20000 percentile bootstrap draws; resample three parent groups with replacement within each of six fixed families; carry all three sizes together
statistics.complete_service: Same parent/size aggregation using the indicator served == n
statistics.limits: Subgroups exploratory; small within-family samples limit interval precision; no epoch-level pseudo-replication; non-significance is not equivalence
statistics.primary: Mean across parents of the equal-weight mean of their three size-specific (ALNS served/n - HGS served/n) differences
secondary: Distance/operations only on identical served customer sets
statistics.superiority: Primary mean > 0 and 95% lower bound > 0; complete-service 95% lower bound >= 0; every paired run passes physics/information/five-second audits; no missing pair
